description_en: Configures SSL encryption for an dedicated proxy endpoint of an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance
description_zh: 该接口用于设置RDS MySQL数据库代理连接地址的SSL加密
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-db-proxy-instance-ssl --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id rm-t4n3a0000 --db-proxy-endpoint-id ta9um40000 --db-proxy-connect-string test123456.rwlb.rds.aliyuncs.com --db-proxy-ssl-enabled 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDbProxyInstanceSsl

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the proxy endpoint. You can call the DescribeDBProxyEndpoint operation to query the ID of the proxy endpoint
parameters.help_zh: 代理连接地址ID。可以通过接口DescribeDBProxyEndpoint查看
parameters.name: db_proxy_endpoint_id

parameters.help_en: The dedicated proxy endpoint of the instance
parameters.name: db_proxy_connect_string

parameters.help_en:
The SSL configuration setting that you want to apply on the instance. Valid values:

0: disables SSL encryption.
1: enables SSL encryption or modifies the endpoint that requires SSL encryption.
2: updates the validity period of the SSL certificate.

This setting causes your instance to restart. Proceed with caution
parameters.help_zh:
对SSL加密执行的操作，取值：
0：关闭SSL加密
1：开启SSL加密或修改SSL加密地址
2：更新证书有效期

执行以上操作会重启实例，请谨慎操作
parameters.name: db_proxy_ssl_enabled

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.name: db_proxy_engine_type
